The baseline TatarTTS models were created by training separate single-speaker models for each of the two speakers (one male and one female) using VITS models. The models were initialized randomly and trained for 1,000 epochs per speaker on the TatarTTS dataset, which contains 70 hours of transcribed speech from two speakers. The training was conducted on NVIDIA DGX servers using A100 GPUs. The models were trained with a relatively limited amount of speech data (30 hours per speaker) and achieved reasonably good performance in terms of MOS.
